description: Reads or writes project.godot: settings, autoloads, the main scene, input actions, plugins and audio buses. project_info include lists the autoloads, input actions and audio buses as the project holds them. A write with an editor open on the project is handed to the editor, which takes the settings the write changed or names from the file (named under editorAdopted), including a setting the file already held, since the editor can hold another value after the file was put back, or reloads the bus layout, so it answers the new values and does not save the old ones back over them. editorNote is an editor that could not take the write, or one on another release's addon that was not asked, which still holds the old values until editor_launch restart. An enabled plugin's code still loads on the editor's next start. set answers old_value and new_value, with was_new true when project.godot did not set the setting before, and was_default true when what it held was the engine's own default, which old_value then is. add_input_action on an action that exists, one of the engine's ui_ actions included, replaces its events, and its deadzone when one is given, and answers was_new false with what it held under old_events and old_deadzone. A set of the value the setting already holds, in the same type, writes nothing and answers unchanged true and saved false. unset takes a setting's line out of project.godot, the way back from a set of a misspelt name, and answers removed, old_value and default_value, the value that holds now (null for a setting the engine does not declare); on one the file does not set it answers removed false and writes nothing. Every write keeps the sections and keys of project.godot in the order the file had them, so a change moves no other line; the save is the engine's, and like the editor's it writes Godot's header and config/features into a file that lacks them. get answers exists, true for any setting the engine knows, and at_default, true when the value is the engine's own default and so has no line in project.godot. Each setting under prefix carries at_default too, so a family read separates what the project sets from the engine's defaults; it is absent for a setting the engine registers no default for, such as an input action the project added, which only the project can have set. Operations: get: read one setting, or every setting under prefix; set (needs setting, value): write one setting; unset (needs setting): take a setting out of project.godot, so the engine default holds; add_autoload (needs name, path): register an autoload singleton; remove_autoload (needs name): unregister an autoload; set_main_scene (needs scenePath): choose the scene the game starts in; add_input_action (needs actionName, events): register an input action and its events, or rebind one that exists; remove_input_action (needs actionName): remove an input action the project defines; enable_plugin (needs pluginName): enable an addon; disable_plugin (needs pluginName): disable an addon; add_audio_bus (needs busName): add an audio bus; remove_audio_bus (needs busName): remove an audio bus, sending what sent to it on to where it sent; set_audio_bus_effect (needs busIndex, effectIndex, effectType): put an effect in a slot on a bus; set_audio_bus_volume (needs busIndex, volumeDb): set a bus volume.

actionName.description: Input action name, such as "jump". Only for ops add_input_action, remove_input_action.

busIndex.description: Audio bus index. Only for ops set_audio_bus_effect, set_audio_bus_volume.

busName.description: Audio bus name. Only for ops add_audio_bus, remove_audio_bus.

deadzone.description: Input actions: analogue deadzone, 0 to 1. Default: the deadzone of the action being rebound, or 0.5 for a new one. Only for op add_input_action.

effectIndex.description: Slot on the bus for the effect: the effect there is replaced, and one past the last adds one. Any other slot is refused. Only for op set_audio_bus_effect.

effectType.description: Effect class, such as "AudioEffectReverb". Only for op set_audio_bus_effect.

enabled.description: add_autoload: Godot 4 loads every autoload in the list, so false is refused. Use global: false to keep the name out of the global scope, or remove_autoload to stop it loading. set_audio_bus_effect: whether the effect is on. Default true. Only for ops add_autoload, set_audio_bus_effect.

events.description: The events that trigger the action, each bound to every device, as the editor binds them. A read names device only on an event bound to one device. Only for op add_input_action.

alt.description: Keys: bind it with Alt held.

button.description: Mouse: 1 left, 2 right, 3 middle. Joypad: the button index.

ctrl.description: Keys: bind it with Ctrl held.

keycode.description: Keys: the key name, such as "Space" or "W".

physical.description: Keys: bind the key by where it sits on the keyboard (physical_keycode) rather than by what it types, as the editor offers, so W stays the key above S on any layout. Default false.

shift.description: Keys: bind it with Shift held.

from.description: get: where to read. Default disk, which starts a short-lived engine and reads project.godot, needs no editor and is what an automatic check can reproduce. editor asks the open editor instead, which costs no engine and answers what the editor holds, including changes nobody has saved. Asking for editor with none connected is refused rather than answered from disk, so an answer never means the other one quietly. Only for op get.

global.description: Autoloads: make the name a global variable, the * in project.godot and the editor's "Global Variable" column. Default true. The autoload loads either way. Only for op add_autoload.

name.description: Autoload name. Only for ops add_autoload, remove_autoload.

parentBusIndex.description: Audio buses: the bus to send to. Default 0, Master. The new bus goes right after it, so every later bus moves one along, and the answer lists them all. Only for op add_audio_bus.

path.description: Autoload script or scene inside the project. Only for op add_autoload.

pluginName.description: Folder name under addons/. Only for ops enable_plugin, disable_plugin.

prefix.description: get: answer with every setting whose name starts with this, and the type the engine registers for each, instead of one setting by name. "debug/gdscript/warnings/" answers the whole family. The type matters: a family of levels can hold a setting that is a bool, and writing a level over it looks like it worked. Only for op get.

projectPath.description: Absolute path to the project directory, the one holding project.godot.

scenePath.description: Scene file inside the project, such as "scenes/main.tscn" or "res://scenes/main.tscn". Only for op set_main_scene.

setting.description: Setting path, such as "display/window/size/viewport_width". Only for ops get, set, unset.

value.description: The value to write, fitted to the type the setting is registered as, the way scene_node set fits a property. Engine types may be written as their fields, {"x": 1, "y": 2}, or tagged, {"_type": "Vector2", "x": 1, "y": 2}, and infinity as {"_type": "float", "value": "inf"}, the form a read answers with; one carrying a field its type has not is refused naming it, and a colour may also be its html code, "#ff8000". "" writes an empty string. A setting the engine does not declare is written as given, a whole number as an int, and when one in its section is named like it, note names the nearest, as it may be a misspelt one. Only for op set.

volumeDb.description: Bus volume in decibels. Only for op set_audio_bus_volume.

name: project_settings
title: Project settings
